settings.name: DatabaseType
settings.help: SqlServer, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySql, Oracle

settings.name: TemplateType
settings.help: Ef6, EfCore8-10

settings.name: ConnectionString
settings.help: This is used by the generator to reverse engineer your database

settings.name: ConnectionStringActions
settings.help: EFCore only. Additional method chain to append to the database provider setup in OnConfiguring. e.g. ".EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 10, maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), errorNumbersToAdd: null)"

settings.name: ConnectionStringName
settings.help: ConnectionString key as specified in your app.config/web.config/appsettings.json. Not used by the generator, but is placed into the generated DbContext constructor.

settings.name: DbContextName
settings.help: Class name for the DbContext to be generated.

settings.name: DbContextInterfaceName
settings.help: Defaults to "I" + DbContextName or set string empty to not implement any interface.

settings.name: Namespace
settings.help: Override the default namespace here. Please use double quotes, example: "Accounts.Billing"

settings.name: UseFileScopedNamespaces
settings.help: If true, uses C# 10 file-scoped namespace syntax (namespace X;) instead of block-scoped (namespace X { })

settings.name: AddUnitTestingDbContext
settings.help: Will add a FakeDbContext and FakeDbSet for easy unit testing. Read https://github.com/ReversePOCO/EntityFramework-Reverse-POCO-Code-First-Generator/wiki/FakeDbContext

settings.name: FakeDbContextInDebugOnlyMode
settings.help: If true, wraps Fake* classes in #if DEBUG / #endif so they are excluded from Release builds.

settings.name: ElementsToGenerate
settings.help: Combine with |. None, Poco, Context, Interface, PocoConfiguration, Enum

settings.name: ContextFolder
settings.help: Sub-folder you would like your DbContext to be added to.              e.g. @"Data"

settings.name: InterfaceFolder
settings.help: Sub-folder you would like your Interface to be added to.              e.g. @"Data\Interface"

settings.name: PocoFolder
settings.help: Sub-folder you would like your Poco's to be added to.                 e.g. @"Data\Entities"

settings.name: PocoConfigurationFolder
settings.help: Sub-folder you would like your Configuration mappings to be added to. e.g. @"Data\Configuration"

settings.name: UseFolderNameInNamespace
settings.help: If true, appends the sub-folder name to the namespace. e.g. PocoFolder = "Entities" => namespace MyProject.Entities

settings.name: CommandTimeout
settings.help: SQL Command timeout in seconds. 600 is 10 minutes, 0 will wait indefinitely. Some databases can be slow retrieving schema information.

settings.name: DbContextInterfaceBaseClasses
settings.help: Specify what the base classes are for your database context interface

settings.name: DbContextBaseClass
settings.help: Specify what the base class is for your DbContext. For ASP.NET Identity use "IdentityDbContext<ApplicationUser>";

settings.name: OnConfiguration
settings.help: Configuration, ConnectionString, Omit. EFCore only. Determines the code generated within DbContext.OnConfiguration(). Please read https://github.com/ReversePOCO/EntityFramework-Reverse-POCO-Code-First-Generator/wiki/Settings.OnConfiguration

settings.name: AddParameterlessConstructorToDbContext
settings.help: EF6 only. If true, then DbContext will have a default (parameter-less) constructor which automatically passes in the connection string name, if false then no parameter-less constructor will be created.

settings.name: ConfigurationClassName
settings.help: Configuration, Mapping, Map, etc. This is appended to the Poco class name to configure the mappings.

settings.name: TableSuffix
settings.help: Appended to every generated class name: "Dto" turns Order into OrderDto, "Entity" into OrderEntity. null adds nothing.

settings.name: UseMappingTables
settings.help: If true, mapping will be used, and no mapping tables will be generated. If false, all tables will be generated.

settings.name: EntityClassesModifiers
settings.help: "public partial";

settings.name: ConfigurationClassesModifiers
settings.help: "public partial";

settings.name: DbContextClassModifiers
settings.help: "public partial";

settings.name: DbContextInterfaceModifiers
settings.help: "public partial";

settings.name: ResultClassModifiers
settings.help: "public partial";

settings.name: UsePascalCase
settings.help: This will rename the generated C# tables & properties to use PascalCase. If false table & property names will be left alone.

settings.name: UseDataAnnotations
settings.help: If true, will add data annotations to the poco classes.

settings.name: UsePropertyInitialisers
settings.help: Removes POCO constructor and instead uses C# 6 property initialisers to set defaults

settings.name: UseLazyLoading
settings.help: Marks all navigation properties as virtual or not, to support or disable EF Lazy Loading feature

settings.name: UseInheritedBaseInterfaceFunctions
settings.help: If true, the main DBContext interface functions will come from the DBContextInterfaceBaseClasses and not generated. If false, the functions will be generated.

settings.name: IncludeComments
settings.help: None, InSummaryBlock, AtEndOfField. Adds comments to the generated code

settings.name: IncludeExtendedPropertyComments
settings.help: None, InSummaryBlock, AtEndOfField. Adds extended properties as comments to the generated code

settings.name: DisableGeographyTypes
settings.help: Turns off use of spatial types: Geography, Geometry. More info: https://github.com/ReversePOCO/EntityFramework-Reverse-POCO-Code-First-Generator/wiki/Spatial-Types

settings.name: CollectionInterfaceType
settings.help: = "System.Collections.Generic.List"; // Determines the declaration type of collections for the Navigation Properties. ICollection is used if not set.

settings.name: CollectionType
settings.help: Determines the type of collection for the Navigation Properties. "ObservableCollection" for example. Add "System.Collections.ObjectModel" to AdditionalNamespaces if setting the CollectionType = "ObservableCollection".

settings.name: NullableShortHand
settings.help: true => T?, false => Nullable<T>

settings.name: AddIDbContextFactory
settings.help: Will add a default IDbContextFactory<DbContextName> implementation for easy dependency injection

settings.name: UsePrivateSetterForComputedColumns
settings.help: If the columns is computed, use a private setter.

settings.name: IncludeGeneratorVersionInCode
settings.help: If true, will include the version number of the generator in the generated code (Settings.ShowLicenseInfo must also be true).

settings.name: TrimCharFields
settings.help: EF Core option only. If true, will TrimEnd() 'char' fields when read from the database.

settings.name: IncludeFieldNameConstants
settings.help: Will include public const string {{NameHumanCase}}Field = "{{NameHumanCase}}"; in the generated POCO class. It allows you to use a constant instead of magic strings.

settings.name: UsePropertiesForStoredProcResultSets
settings.help: Stored procedure result set return models are rendered as fields (false) or properties (true).

settings.name: MergeMultipleStoredProcModelsIfAllSame
settings.help: Some stored procedures are reported as having multiple result sets when in fact there is only one. Set this to true to merge identical result sets.

settings.name: AdditionalNamespaces
settings.help: To include extra namespaces, include them here. i.e. new List<string> { "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore", "System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations" };

settings.name: AdditionalContextInterfaceItems
settings.help: example: new List<string> { "void SetAutoDetectChangesEnabled(bool flag);" };

settings.name: AdditionalFileHeaderText
settings.help: This will put additional lines verbatim at the top of each file under the comments, 1 line per entry

settings.name: AdditionalFileFooterText
settings.help: This will put additional lines verbatim at the end of each file above the // </auto-generated>, 1 line per entry

settings.name: UseRegions
settings.help: If false, suppresses the use of #region

settings.name: UseNamespace
settings.help: If false, suppresses the writing of a namespace

settings.name: UsePragma
settings.help: If false, suppresses the writing of #pragma

settings.name: AllowNullStrings
settings.help: If true, will allow string? properties and will add '#nullable enable' to the top of each file

settings.name: NullableReverseNavigationProperties
settings.help: If true, reverse navigation properties for one-to-one relationships will be nullable (e.g. MyEntity? MyEntity). The parent entity can exist without the child entity.

settings.name: UseResharper
settings.help: If true, will add a list of 'ReSharper disable' comments to the top of each file

settings.name: ShowLicenseInfo
settings.help: If true, will add the licence info comment to the top of each file

settings.name: IncludeConnectionSettingComments
settings.help: Add comments describing connection settings used to generate file

settings.name: IncludeCodeGeneratedAttribute
settings.help: If true, will include the [GeneratedCode] attribute before classes, false to remove it.

settings.name: IncludeColumnsWithDefaults
settings.help: If true, will set properties to the default value from the database.

settings.name: GenerateHasDefaultValueSql
settings.help: EFCore only. If true, will emit .HasDefaultValueSql() in the entity configuration for columns with a SQL default, making defaults queryable via EF model reflection.

settings.name: Enumerations
UsePascalCaseForEnumMembers
settings.help: Renames the generated enum members to PascalCase. If false, members keep the names the table holds.

settings.name: HiLoSequences
AddJsonColumnMappings
settings.section: JSON column to POCO class mapping

AdditionalReverseNavigationsDataAnnotations
settings.section: Additional attributes on on reverse navigation and foreign key properties

settings.section: Additional attributes on on reverse navigation and foreign key properties
